title: Build a presale commit for the Blast wallet
description: POST /api/social/me/commits: the sale, its exact on-chain quote coin selected by QUOTE, the commitment in the sale's quote-coin atoms, and for an allowlisted sale the Blast wallet's leaf as the presale proof route answers it.

amount.description: A u64 of quote-coin atoms, at least 1.

proof.description: A Merkle proof, leaf to root; at most 16 entries (65,536 leaves); 32 bytes as 64 lowercase hex characters without 0x.

swap_quote_id.description: An offered, sealed swap into the presale's exact quote type. amount is its guaranteed min_out.
